outcome.answer: The supplied papers do not directly answer how repeating training data affects model performance during pretraining. The closest relevant result is that a model further adapted on organically collected Tulu social media text outperformed a baseline on development data, suggesting that more in-domain training data can help, but it does not study repeated data during pretraining specifically [2]. Another paper shows monolingual models trained from scratch on cleaned data outperform a shared multilingual model on several downstream tasks, but it does not isolate the effect of duplicating training examples [10].
